description:
A lightweight desktop AI client and screen-level agent: chat, tools, translation, OCR, and visual Q&A in one small app.

Kivio is a compact desktop AI client with a built-in agent runtime. It stays in the tray or menu bar, opens when you need it, and keeps a much smaller footprint than a browser-based AI workspace.
- Kivio Agent — chat, projects, assistants, memory, file/image attachments, MCP, Skills, and native tools (file ops, shell, web fetch/search, Pyodide run_python).
- Lens — screenshot-based visual Q&A, OCR, formula extraction, text polishing, and optional web-aware answers.
- Fast translation — typed text, selected text, windows, and arbitrary screen regions.
- Bring your own models — OpenAI-compatible providers and Anthropic Messages, with per-feature model routing and multi-key failover.
- Document-ready — PDF / Word / Excel workflows run on a bundled offline Pyodide sandbox, no first-run CDN download required.
- Private by default — no telemetry; API keys and conversation data stay on your machine.
Kivio Desktop v4.0.0
桌面 AI 助手 · macOS (Apple Silicon) + Windows。Desktop AI assistant for macOS (Apple Silicon) and Windows.
下载 / Downloads
- Windows 安装包 / Installer: Kivio.Desktop_4.0.0_x64-setup.exe（NSIS）。
- Windows 便携版 / Portable: Kivio.Desktop_4.0.0_x64-portable.zip，解压后运行 Kivio Desktop.exe / unzip and run.
  - 需要 Edge WebView2，设置和对话与安装版共用。Requires Edge WebView2; settings and conversations are shared with the installed app.
  - 应用内更新使用安装包；继续使用便携版请手动下载新 ZIP。In-app updates use the installer; download the new ZIP manually to remain portable.
- macOS: Kivio.Desktop_4.0.0_aarch64.dmg（Apple Silicon，临时签名、未公证 / ad-hoc signed, not notarized）。
  - 首次启动可右键打开；系统阻止打开时，可运行 xattr -cr "/Applications/Kivio Desktop.app"。更新后可能需要重新授权。
  - Right-click to open on first launch. If macOS blocks the app, run the command above. Permissions may need to be granted again after updating.
新版本亮点 / What's new
以下是 v3.1.9 → v4.0.0 的变更。These changes cover v3.1.9 → v4.0.0.
- 设置界面 / Settings: 统一页面分组、控件尺寸、主题颜色与布局，重排供应商和外部代理设置，将提示词正文移入编辑弹窗。Unify page groups, control sizes, theme colors, and layouts; reorganize provider and external-agent settings and edit prompts in dialogs.
- 屏幕工具 / Screen tools: Lens 和截图翻译支持按模型选择推理强度，迁移旧思考开关，固定使用流式输出。Lens 默认在浮窗内回答，已有发送到聊天的选择会保留。Choose model-supported reasoning levels for Lens and screenshot translation, migrate previous thinking settings, and always stream output. Lens answers in its overlay by default and preserves an existing send-to-chat choice.
- 聊天操作 / Chat interactions: 回到历史提问时恢复文字与附件，重新打开侧栏时恢复上次标签；改善会话切换、阅读位置恢复、滚动跟随、追问和长消息折叠。Restore text and attachments when rewinding and remember the selected sidebar tab. Improve conversation switching, reading-position recovery, follow scrolling, follow-up questions, and collapsed long messages.
- 聊天渲染 / Chat rendering: 流式输出只更新当前回答行，限制缓存并释放闲置渲染资源，减少切换时的重复解析与读取；修复消息重叠、工具调用期间回答不可见和 Markdown 波浪线显示。Update only the active answer row during streaming, bound caches, release inactive rendering resources, and reduce repeated parsing and reads during navigation. Fix overlapping messages, hidden answers during tool calls, and literal tildes in Markdown.
- 用量统计 / Usage: 使用 SQLite 记录用量，增加本地 CLI 成本统计与按来源查看趋势，修复模型计价映射和后台补价。Record usage in SQLite, track local CLI costs, show trends by source, and fix model pricing matches and background cost updates.
- 备份恢复 / Backup and restore: 本地 ZIP 与云端备份可选择配置备份或包含聊天和附件的全量备份，支持恢复；备份聊天前检查仍在运行的对话。Choose configuration-only or full chat-and-attachment backups locally or in the cloud, and restore them. Check for active conversations before exporting chat backups.
- 外部代理与搜索 / External agents and search: Pi 和 dsh 接入 Kivio-server 工具，自动识别 dsh 桌面版 CLI，修复其实时输出及失败尝试片段；新增 SpecStream 搜索供应商。Connect Pi and dsh to Kivio-server tools, detect the dsh desktop CLI, repair live output and failed-attempt cleanup, and add the SpecStream search provider.
- 模型与运行时 / Models and runtime: 保留推理内容并修正缓存用量，限制未完成 SSE 事件的缓冲大小，改善运行取消、会话快照隔离和超时识别。Preserve reasoning content, correct cached-token usage, bound incomplete SSE event buffers, and improve cancellation, session-snapshot isolation, and timeout detection.
- 桌面与打包 / Desktop and packaging: 修复 Windows 窗口缩放时的图形句柄泄漏、屏蔽 WebView 原生查找快捷键，并补全 macOS 应用包签名和发布前的签名及资源校验。Fix Windows graphics-handle leaks during resizing, disable WebView's native find shortcut, and complete macOS bundle signing with signature and resource checks before publication.
验证边界 / Validation limits
- 自动构建与测试不替代桌面实机验收；安装升级、权限、真实备份恢复和外部 CLI 服务仍需在目标环境验证。Automated builds and tests do not replace desktop acceptance; installation, upgrades, permissions, real backup restores, and external CLI services require validation in their target environments.
- macOS 使用临时签名且未公证，Windows 安装包未签名。macOS uses ad-hoc signing without notarization; the Windows installer is unsigned.
完整变更 / Full changelog: https://github.com/ZMGID/kivio/compare/v3.1.9...v4.0.0
